n: Using Twine to do Close Reading of Poetry
t: A short teacher proposal for building Twine games around a poem passage.
steps: Open the proposal on itch.io and read it.
Choose a short poem passage for your class.
Download Twine from its own site or open the browser version.
Build a small model game around your passage.
Plan how students will share their games.
Decide how the games will feed into an essay.
Look at the Programming Historian lesson or the ACMI unit for more developed Twine lessons.
